## Release Notes: Disruption March 20, 2025

The Network360 Team is excited to share the latest updates designed to enhance your experience on the Disruption platform.

### Here’s what’s new in this release:

1. Simplified Navigation Path for Easier Access
2. File Validation Enhancement for Duplicate Column Names
3. Improved Quality Score Calculation for Name Field Mappings

### Key Highlights

#### 1.	Simplified Navigation Path for Easier Access

* **What You’ll See:** The navigation path has been updated for a more consistent experience across the platform.

  **Example:** Home > Manage Disruption Analyses > Utilization Files > Edit: Test File

![](/cms/cms-assets/media/navigation.png)

* **How It Helps:** It’s now easier to navigate between different pages, making your workflow more intuitive.

#### 2.	File Validation Enhancement for Duplicate Columns

* **What’s new:** You can now upload files with duplicate column names — the system will automatically rename them (Paid, Paid_2, Paid_3, etc.) so you don’t have to fix them manually.
* **How It Helps:** Your uploads won’t fail because of duplicate column names. No need to adjust your files.

#### 3.	Improved Quality Score Calculation for Name Mappings

* **What’s new:** We’ve refined how the quality score works for name fields during file review:

  * If you map Full Name, the system skips checking First and Last Name.
  * If you map First Name and Last Name, the system ignores Full Name.
* **How It Helps:** This ensures more accurate quality scores, even if only one of the name fields is mapped.

### Conclusion

These updates bring improvements to your navigation, file validation, and quality score calculations. We’re always working to enhance your experience, and if you have any questions, don’t hesitate to reach out!
